name: Keekiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional cake shop: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at the shop, a birthday-cake price-plan guide, a free tasting-event notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, a story about noticing a regular customer's change in taste through good service, a lesson teaching a new part-timer the basics of cream piping, an explainer on why the shop still uses an old stone oven, a free decoration-service application guide, a column on how online cake sales changed the shop's work, a Christmas-season reservation rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's skill for judging dough by hand, and a one-year neighboring-confectioners-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
